scientific_limitations: The local Jacobian Hurwitz inequalities are only at the inner-cycle point and do not prove global Hurwitzness.
The globally Hurwitz parameter region and attraction of the outer cycle are established in the cited original source, not independently reproduced here.
Exact isochrons are asserted on the attracting basin, not on the axis or beyond the basin; no explicit basin boundary is given.
The conjugating maps are analytic but not polynomial.
title: Global analytic phase-gauge conjugacy and a sharp Hurwitz obstruction in a periodic polynomial flow
